ingameEffects.label: Lingering Cries (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency, stacking up to 4 times.
